**Abstract**

Natural language call routing can be treated as an instance of topic categorization of documents after speech recognition of calls. This categorization consists of two important parts. The first one is text preprocessing for numerical data extraction and the second one is classification with machine learning algorithms. The main goal of this paper is to present how different text categorization methods were applied in order to improve a natural language call routing system. In this work we have experimented with different techniques from both parts of this categorization. From text preprocessing part, we tested a number of methods for the numerical data extraction including regular expressions, NER and rule-based approaches. From the machine learning part, we experimented with a number of well-known classification techniques like SVM, k-NN, random forests, decision trees. We tested our models on a dataset that we built. Our results show that we get good results when we combine the best numerical data extraction method (rule based approach) with a strong classifier (random forests or decision trees).

generations.raw_text: Insightful findings in political science often require researchers to analyze documents of a certain subject or type. However, these documents are usually contained in large corpora that do not distinguish between relevant and irrelevant documents. In contrast, we can find that the method of adaptive ensembling, which is an unsupervised domain adaptation approach, can be effectively applied to perform document analysis. Our study has shown that this method can improve the performance of text classification and clustering tasks when transferring knowledge from one corpus (the source domain) to another corpus (the target domain). The proposed method selects features that are discriminative to the target domain and then uses a classifier that is trained on the source domain, but adapted to the target domain. By applying our method to several public datasets, we show that our approach yields better results than some common existing methods. Therefore, we recommend the use of adaptive ensembling as a tool for performing political document analysis.

Purpose – The purpose of this study is to explore the causal link between procurement route and ongoing buyer-supplier relationship.

Design/methodology/approach – The research draws on literature in the areas of: facilities management (FM) outsourcing; purchasing and supply chain management; service management and business process management (BPM). In particular, this paper is based on the review of literature, analysis of secondary data, and case study research methods. To investigate the problem in question, a questionnaire was distributed to 1200 facilities management (FM) firms from Europe, Asia, North America, and South America. 852 responses were received. After screening the questionnaires, 498 were valid and used in the analysis. The data were analysed using multiple regression techniques. The findings have been reported using tables and figures.

Findings – The results show that there is a significant relationship between the use of internal procurement route and the ongoing buyer-supplier relationship. There is also a significant relationship between the use of external procurement route and the ongoing buyer-supplier relationship. Furthermore, the effect of the use of the internal procurement route on the buyer-supplier relationship is more significant than the effect of the external procurement route.

Research limitations/implications – This study has only taken into account one kind of procurement routes. Future studies could consider more factors which influence the buyer-supplier relationship. For example, the impact of procurement price, the impact of procurement quality and the impact of procurement time.

Practical implications – In the process of facility management (FM), managers should pay attention to the selection of procurement route. By selecting appropriate procurement route, we can get the good ongoing buyer-supplier relationship.

Originality/value – This research provides useful information and insights regarding the impact of the use of internal procurement route or external procurement route on the buyer-supplier relationship. It will be beneficial for the practitioners.

generations.raw_text: The widespread availability of many emerging services enabled by the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm passes through the capability to provide long-range connectivity to a massive number of things, overcoming the well-known issues of ad-hoc, short-range networks. This paper investigates how to support massive machine-to-machine (M2M) traffic in heterogeneous networks (HetNets) and 5G cellular networks. We present a novel approach that enables HetNets and 5G networks to cope with the massive M2M traffic load while at the same time providing good Quality of Service (QoS). Our approach relies on HetNets with multi-cell multi-point coordination transmission and we also investigate how to implement HetNets in 5G networks. The performance of our proposed system is evaluated in terms of throughput and delay using Monte Carlo simulations and results show that our approach can provide both high throughput and delay guarantees with good fairness.

We also found that this mutation leads to upregulation of several important early B cell genes, suggesting that this complex acts as a key negative regulator to control the expression of these early B cell genes. Together, these results indicate that the Sel1L-Hrd1 complex plays a key role in the negative regulation of the expression of some important early B cell genes and the positive regulation of the expression of some important late B cell genes, acting as a check point at the early B cell stage.
